scope: All 28 current rocker, guided, single-switch parallel and dual-switch parallel macro/fixture variants pass native geometry, external component interference, independent occurrence movement and STEP/FCStd roundtrips. Fourteen unchanged nonparallel proofs are retained only with exact macro and fixture hashes; all fourteen changed parallel variants are checked with the corrected source orientation. Both parallel ASW-07D sources rotate 180 degrees in the construction frame (90 degrees in the final dual world frame), preserving body centres while placing their horizontal ground terminals and matching open cradle channels on positive construction X. Ground-clip fixtures and host-panel branches check the positive-X approach, which becomes the negative-Y operator edge on the dual plate. Servo and rocker press-ON use positive 76.336799815 degrees and press-OFF negative, with inherited source first/last OFF/ON mapping. The single parallel assembly retains 24 components and 40 native solids; the dual retains 30 components and 59. All installed parallel presets prove common PETG flange bottom Z0.8 and top Z6.8, all flange volume supported by its actual first-layer footprint, zero interior downward ceilings and a detected blind-pocket negative control. Nominal 0.8 mm TPU sheets remain outside the flat flange and clear the cradle. Split shoulders, through-tie engagement, antirotation pockets, ground/cable approaches and 1/3/6 mm host panels remain checked. The dual preserves manual ARM 1 on the left and servo ARM 2 on the right, with 0.6 mm legends at Z6.2 floor. Rotated SAC and manual-lever sweeps pass. A diameter 3 mm straight-key approach clears all fixed hardware at both rear ties; the removable cover obstructs tie 1 at actual world [-101,+22] in open and closed modeled poses, while tie 2 at [-79,-22] clears. Fit tie 1 before the cover or remove the cover for straight-key service. Actual plugs, delivered guard adjustment, electrical behavior, force, printed strength, TPU compression and material performance remain unverified.
